content:
Introducing the latest in our family of packagesroc-docx-- for all your WordML document parsing, reviewing/editing and generation needs.

https://github.com/lukewilliamboswell/roc-docx

It's just an RC for now as I'm still testing it manually and building things with it... but from what I can see so far it feel pretty capable and quite performant.

I asked Claude to use roc-fuzz and maintain various targets to control for correctness and ratchet allocations/performance as we filled out the APIs and that seems to have worked quite well.

Lets me know if you use it or find any rough edges. I plan on building various apps using this for working with business documents.

Here's a sneak peek at the playground I've built for it... that is waiting for some features to land in roc-signals before it's ready to go. The idea is following the spine of the roc-docx pipeline so you can "see" inside a .docx file with everything it contains, and then also work with those.

Screen Recording 2026-11-10 at 17.34.45.mov
If anyone is interested in trying it out... the playground is now live at https://lukewilliamboswell.github.io/roc-docx/playground/
I had an agent throw it together in a few minutes ... it's purpose is more for playing with the Roc package interactively.
I have been using computers since before docx came out, and I just realized they added the x because it's xml :joy:
Although I did learn about xml only after I had been using docx for some years :)
I love this :grinning_face_with_smiling_eyes:
